set: A: one sheet across each of the seven beats, with no time and no word on it

issues.where: frames 4 to 9, the arrow over the checkbox
issues.what: it just steps along the checkbox in small slides like a real pointer; no pose change, no lean or wobble, so the hesitation (if that's what it is) doesn't read as a feeling, and the click in frame 10 has no anticipation and no squash
issues.fix: give it a clear hover pose (lean back, slight tip-up) held for 3-4 frames, then a wind-up rise and a visible squash on the click, followed by a little upright pop of pride when 'Humanity Confirmed' appears

issues.where: frames 4 to 12, the arrow lower left while popups land around it
issues.what: error popups land right next to it and it keeps the same rigid right-pointing pose; it does not flinch, recoil or squash, so the hits from the machine don't read as hits on it
issues.fix: on each popup landing near or on it, add a 2-3 frame flinch: squash on contact, a knock-back tilt, then a recover; give each shot a small recoil stretch back along its axis

issues.where: frames 4 to 10, the arrow at the Submit button
issues.what: the final click, the payoff of the unit, is not clearly staged: the arrow is crumpled and overlaps the button, but there is no readable wind-up, press squash or reaction after it, so it's hard to tell whether it clicked and how it feels about it
issues.fix: hold a clear exhausted pose, then a slow lift as wind-up, a hard squash press on the button, and a held relieved or triumphant pose for at least 6 frames before the page tilts

issues.where: frames 6 to 12, the arrow lower left while the machine builds itself
issues.what: after the knock-back the arrow mostly hangs in place in a near-neutral pointer pose as the button transforms; the surprise and alarm are not pushed or held, so it reads as idle
issues.fix: after the knock-back, hold a big shocked stretch (tall, tipped back) and then a cower or backing-off pose that tracks the machine as it grows

issues.what: the crumpled/hurt pose is good but very small; at delivery size the bent silhouette is only ~20 px and reads as a smudge more than a slump
issues.fix: push the crumple further (stronger bend, lower) and hold it a couple more frames so the silhouette reads at a glance

issues.where: frames 1 to 4, the arrow ramming the machine
issues.what: the ram reads, but there is no stretch on the charge in and no squash on impact; the arrow keeps its normal shape while hitting a much bigger object
issues.fix: stretch it along its axis on the run in, squash it hard on contact, then let it bounce out before the explosion

issues.what: did not read: the dialogs are read as things the machine throws at the arrow, like the slabs before them. That they stand up as shields in front of the machine, and that the arrow has to shoot them down or go round them, is not in the read; the hit and the going on are.
issues.fix: The dialogs standing up between the arrow and the machine and taking its darts, one of them shot down or gone round in plain view, before the hit.

issues.what: did not read: the words Session expired are read as a hit that crumples the arrow. That the machine was nearly beaten, that its bar jumps back up a little, and the arrow's whole body saying really, are not in the read; the charge that finishes it is.
issues.fix: The bar's jump back up seen in the sheet, and the arrow's answer to it as a held pose of disbelief that is not a hurt pose, before it goes back in.

reads.read: breezy and confident: it flips in, tips over cockily, then drifts to the 'I am not a robot' box, hesitates over it, ticks it and gets 'Humanity Confirmed'; it is pleased and about to go submit

satisfied, then startled: it reaches the Submit button, the button tears out of the page and knocks it sideways, then armours itself into a walking machine with a shield; the arrow is left stunned and wary, keeping its distance

determined and angry: it turns to face the machine and starts shooting (its tip glows like a hot barrel), the shots hit the shield and the machine fires error popups back at it ('Field cannot be blank', 'Invalid input', 'Session expired') that land around it
stubborn, keeps firing while the machine throws cookie, session-timeout and 'leave this page?' dialogs at it; an 'Invalid input' popup slams into it and knocks it back, but it keeps shooting
worn down and hurt: after a 'Session expired' hit it crumples and droops, then recovers, gets angry again and charges right up to the machine firing point blank until its tip burns the Submit button

furious, all in: it rams the machine from underneath, the machine blows apart into pieces, then the arrow is dazed and limp, slowly drifting back up among the wreckage toward the scorched Submit button

exhausted and beaten up but triumphant: it creeps to the charred Submit button, 'Click to submit' appears, it crumples and leans in, presses the button wearily, and the page tilts away as the scene ends
